results.question: What is the total paid invoice amount per customer?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_paid_amount FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices i ON s.id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount) FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.subscription_id = s.id WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name

results.question: Which customers have more than one active subscription?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email
FROM customers c
JOIN subscriptions s ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING COUNT(s.id) > 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

results.question: What is the total amount collected from paid invoices for customers in the US?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_collected
FROM invoices i
JOIN subscriptions s ON i.subscription_id = s.id
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.id
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid'
  AND i.paid_date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.country = 'US'
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.subscription_id = s.id WHERE c.country = 'US' AND i.payment_status = 'paid'

results.question: What is the average customer lifetime value, based on paid invoices?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS avg_clv FROM (SELECT c.id, SUM(i.amount - i.tax - i.discount) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.subscription_id = s.id WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id) customer_totals
